items.title: FOFO Business Model Specification & RACI Architecture
items.description: Formulate comprehensive specification of Franchise Owned, Franchise Operated (FOFO) commercial structure, capital division, and operational RACI matrix.
items.requiredEvidence: Approved fofo-operating-model.md ratified in approval matrix
items.acceptanceCriteria: Exhaustive RACI matrix covering 25+ activities with unambiguous franchisor vs franchisee demarcations.

items.title: Franchise Fee Structure & Promotional Tier Policy
items.description: Establish policy for promotional ₹25,000 joining fee (first 10 units) and standard ₹50,000 fee with documented renewal terms.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Clear joining fee terms, renewal fee rates, and waiver boundaries documented without ambiguity.

items.title: 40:60 Net Revenue Sharing Rules & Machine Config
items.description: Define contractual revenue-sharing percentages (40% Franchisee : 60% TMK) and machine-readable JSON configuration.
items.requiredEvidence: Valid revenue-sharing-config.json and verified 100% split tests
items.acceptanceCriteria: Split rule percentages sum to exactly 100% and segregate statutory taxes.

items.title: Six-Product Market Demand Brief & TAM/SAM/SOM Sizing
items.description: Quantify total addressable market and serviceable opportunity for TMK software portfolio across Tier-2/3 Indian markets.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Market sizing grounded in verified research evidence IDs from Nasscom and industry filings.

items.title: Taluka-Based Territory Segmentation Strategy
items.description: Define territorial boundaries utilizing sub-district (Taluka / Tehsil) administrative divisions with TOS scoring.
items.requiredEvidence: Documented taluka territory brief and demographic criteria
items.acceptanceCriteria: Clear taluka allocation criteria preventing regional density conflicts.

items.title: Three-Year Expansion Growth Vision & Wave Rollout Plan
items.description: Establish 36-month expansion trajectory: Wave 1 Pilot (3 units), Wave 2 Western Maharashtra (15 units), Wave 3 Statewide (50 units).
items.acceptanceCriteria: Sequenced wave schedules aligning partner recruitment targets with central deployment capacity.

items.title: Master Franchise Agreement Drafting
items.description: Author complete legal agreement draft specifying license grant, payment terms, territory rules, audit rights, and termination.
items.requiredEvidence: Draft agreement bearing non-binding legal disclaimer header
items.acceptanceCriteria: Comprehensive 15-clause agreement draft covering all standard commercial franchising terms.

items.title: Corporate Legal Counsel Review & Compliance Certification
items.description: Formal vetting by independent corporate legal counsel under Indian Contract Act, Specific Relief Act, and Consumer Protection laws.
items.requiredEvidence: Formal legal opinion memo and counsel sign-off certificate
items.acceptanceCriteria: Signed certification from practicing corporate advocate clearing agreement for market execution.

items.title: Territory Protection Policy & Anti-Encroachment Covenant
items.description: Draft formal legal policy governing 90-day Deal Registration Locks, territorial exclusivity boundaries, and dispute arbitration.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Clear non-encroachment covenants and dispute resolution mechanics.

items.title: Trademark & Brand Usage License Guidelines
items.description: Draft trademark license terms specifying permitted use of TMK IT Solutions logos, trade dress, and signage standards.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Clear trademark protection covenants prohibiting unauthorized brand extensions.

items.title: Franchise Renewal, Buyback & Termination Policies
items.description: Formulate legal policies governing contract renewals, performance hurdle benchmarks, voluntary surrender, and default termination.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Fair exit policies adhering to investor protection standards and clear cure notice windows.

items.title: Non-Disclosure & Mutual Confidentiality Agreement
items.description: Draft bilateral NDA executed with prospective franchise candidates prior to sharing proprietary product documentation.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Trade secret protection covenants covering software code, pricing algorithms, and client lists.

items.title: Cloud Enterprise ERP Commercial Profile & Spec
items.description: Document product feature breakdown, target MSME buyer personas, pricing tiers, and delivery model for prd-01 Enterprise ERP.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Pricing, licensing models, and system requirements verified with engineering.

items.title: School & College Management ERP Commercial Profile
items.description: Document educational software modules (admissions, fee billing, exams) and school demographic targeting.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Module specifications verified against educational customer requirements.

items.title: OMR Examination Software Commercial Profile
items.description: Document optical mark recognition software pricing, offline scanning hardware compatibility, and school evaluation workflows.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Scanning speed benchmarks and printer compatibility verified.

items.title: Property Management ERP Commercial Profile
items.description: Document housing society, commercial real estate, and tenant maintenance billing software modules.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Society billing features and payment gateway integration documented.

items.title: Invoicing & Billing App (Web + Mobile) Commercial Profile
items.description: Document lightweight GST billing application for retail shops and micro-merchants.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Thermal printer and mobile synchronization specs verified.

items.title: Sales CRM Platform Commercial Profile
items.description: Document lead pipeline management, WhatsApp integration, and sales telemetry for regional businesses.
items.acceptanceCriteria: WhatsApp Business API hooks and CRM pipeline workflows verified.

items.title: Live Multi-Tenant Cloud Demonstration Sandbox
items.description: Deploy stable cloud demonstration instances for all 6 products pre-populated with synthetic demonstration data.
items.requiredEvidence: Active URL endpoints with credentials tested across browser test suite
items.acceptanceCriteria: Demonstration environments achieve 99.9% uptime and reset dummy data nightly.

items.title: Competitor Benchmarking & Sales Battlecards
items.description: Equip partners with competitive comparisons against TallyPrime, Marg ERP, Teachmint, Vyapar, and Zoho.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Detailed pricing matrix, feature parity analysis, and objection rebuttals.

items.title: Financial Assumptions Master Config & Schema Compliance
items.description: Establish validated assumptions.json governing CapEx, monthly fixed OpEx, fee schedules, tax rates, and scenarios.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Strict adherence to schemas/financial-assumptions.schema.json with verified scenario parameters.

items.title: Dynamic 10-Sheet Excel Financial Model Generation
items.description: Generate dynamic, formula-linked openpyxl Excel financial model with uppercase formulas and zero hardcoded numbers.
items.acceptanceCriteria: All 10 sheets dynamically recompute upon changing input parameters in Assumptions sheet.

items.title: 36-Month P&L Projections & Break-Even Analysis Summary
items.description: Document narrative summary of monthly cash flows, unit break-even requirements (2 contracts/mo), and payback timeline.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Break-even units mathematically proven to cover fixed monthly overhead of ₹38,000.

items.title: Statutory Pass-Through Tax Isolation Engine (18% GST)
items.description: Verify that all financial models and billing tools isolate 18% GST from gross billing before computing commission splits.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Zero partner commissions calculated on tax-inclusive gross billing amounts.

items.title: Franchisee Working Capital Reserve Verification Standard
items.description: Codify mandatory liquid capital cushion requirement (₹50,000–₹1,00,000 covering 4–6 months overhead) in assumptions.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Working capital reserve enforced as mandatory eligibility condition for candidate vetting.

items.title: Dedicated Franchisor Escrow & Commission Settlement Account
items.description: Establish dedicated commercial bank account and automated escrow disbursement procedure for partner revenue splits.
items.requiredEvidence: Bank mandate letter and settlement workflow documentation
items.acceptanceCriteria: Bank integration established with daily/monthly automated commission reconciliation.

items.title: Franchisee Operations Handbook & Facility Launch SOP
items.description: Author operational handbook detailing office setup, brand signage, daily opening/closing procedures, and customer onboarding.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Step-by-step operating guidelines for all local franchise staff roles.

items.title: Customer Support SLA & Engineering Escalation Matrix
items.description: Establish formal service level agreement defining resolution windows: P1 Critical (< 2h), P2 Major (< 8h), P3 Minor (< 24h).
items.acceptanceCriteria: Signed engineering commitment defining response and resolution SLAs.

items.title: Franchise Unit Physical Onboarding Journey & Milestones
items.description: Document sequential 30-day onboarding journey from contract signing to office launch and commercial go-live.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Day-by-day milestone schedule with clear deliverables for franchisee and franchisor.

items.title: Client Onboarding & Data Migration Protocol
items.description: Standardize standard operating procedure for migrating customer legacy data (Tally XML, Excel sheets) into TMK Cloud ERP.
items.requiredEvidence: Data migration scripts and SOP manual module
items.acceptanceCriteria: Data migration templates tested with zero data truncation across sample customer records.

items.title: Franchise Risk Register & Mitigation Playbooks
items.description: Maintain exhaustive 5x5 risk scoring matrix covering partner default, regulatory change, and competition risks.
items.acceptanceCriteria: 10+ commercial, legal, and technical risks evaluated with actionable mitigation owners.

items.title: Central Partner Portal Architecture & Specification
items.description: Specify multi-tenant partner dashboard architecture for commission tracking, lead registration, and support ticketing.
items.acceptanceCriteria: PRD and database schema contracts defining tenant isolation and portal data models.

items.title: CRM Lead Protection & 90-Day Deal Registration Engine
items.description: Implement automated 90-day prospect locking algorithm in CRM to prevent partner encroachment and channel conflict.
items.requiredEvidence: CRM deal locking module commit and unit test report
items.acceptanceCriteria: System blocks competing franchisee lead registrations on active locked prospect domains.

items.title: Automated Software License Key Provisioning Workflow
items.description: Automate cloud deployment and cryptographic license key generation upon invoice settlement.
items.requiredEvidence: Automated provisioning API endpoint tested in staging
items.acceptanceCriteria: New client instances provisioned in $< 60$ seconds upon payment confirmation.

items.title: Cloud Infrastructure 99.9% High-Availability Deployment
items.description: Deploy resilient containerized Kubernetes / VPS infrastructure with automated daily snapshots and DDoS protection.
items.requiredEvidence: Cloud infrastructure audit report and monitoring dashboard uptime logs
items.acceptanceCriteria: Demonstrated 99.9% uptime over trailing 60 days on staging and production clusters.

items.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Tenant Security Audit
items.description: Enforce strict JWT / OAuth2 authentication ensuring franchisees access only their own territory accounts.
items.requiredEvidence: Automated security test logs in platform/security/security-policy.md
items.acceptanceCriteria: Penetration tests confirm zero cross-tenant data leakage or horizontal privilege escalation.

items.title: Franchise Opportunity Pitch Deck & PPTX Presentation
items.description: Build high-impact 10-slide investor presentation detailing business model, unit economics, 6 products, and revenue potential.
items.requiredEvidence: Generated pitch deck .pptx file in presentations/
items.acceptanceCriteria: Widescreen 16:9 presentation containing statutory non-guarantee earnings disclaimers.

items.title: Franchise Recruitment Commercial Brochure (4-Page)
items.description: Design print-ready marketing brochure highlighting software demand, promotional fee tier, and partner profile.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Professional copy summarizing commercial value proposition and application steps.

items.title: Institutional Franchise Investment Prospectus
items.description: Author comprehensive investment document detailing corporate history, commercial contract terms, unit economics, and risk factors.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Complete disclosure document modeling Conservative, Base, and Optimistic return profiles.

items.title: Candidate Investor FAQ with Non-Guaranteed Return Disclaimers
items.description: Provide answers to 20+ common partner objections regarding CapEx, sales cycles, support escalations, and territory boundaries.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Transparent disclosures clarifying partner operational risk and zero guaranteed returns.

items.title: FOFO Architecture Infographic & Revenue Model Visualizer
items.description: Create graphical specifications depicting money flows, 18% GST deduction, and 40:60 revenue splits.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Accurate visual representation of net revenue split mechanics.

items.title: Digital Lead Capture Funnel & Prospect Evaluation Rubric
items.description: Establish landing page copy, qualification scorecard, and candidate screening criteria for recruitment marketing.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Inbound candidate filtering funnel operational in CRM.

items.title: 10-Day Franchisee Onboarding Training Curriculum
items.description: Establish comprehensive 10-day syllabus covering products, sales pitching, office setup, and support escalations.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Day-by-day lesson plans, practical exercises, and examination modules.

items.title: Sales Executive Product Demonstration Scripts & Playbook
items.description: Create 5-step demonstration scripts, objection battlecards, and sales kits for all software offerings.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Step-by-step talk tracks and value propositions tailored to private schools and MSMEs.

items.title: Operations Manual Examination & Passing Rubric
items.description: Design 100-question written examination requiring 80% passing grade on commercial terms, software, and compliance.
items.requiredEvidence: Examination question bank and answer key
items.acceptanceCriteria: Standardized test instrument administered via online testing portal.

items.title: Formal Partner Certification Accreditation Package
items.description: Establish formal certificate of accreditation, partner badge, and authorization credentials upon passing training.
items.requiredEvidence: Accreditation certificate template and issuance registry
items.acceptanceCriteria: Digital certificate verified with unique partner ID and expiration date.

items.title: Central Engineering Deployment Capacity Verification
items.description: Audit central engineering staff capacity to ensure team can deliver 15+ concurrent client deployments monthly.
items.requiredEvidence: Capacity model and deployment staffing schedule
items.acceptanceCriteria: Staffing ratio certified at 1 central deployment engineer per 10 active franchise units.

items.title: Cloud Server Infrastructure Monitoring & Disaster Recovery
items.description: Implement automated database backup, regional replication, and 15-minute RTO disaster recovery protocol.
items.requiredEvidence: Automated backup cron logs and failover drill report
items.acceptanceCriteria: Successful simulated database restore within 15 minutes of simulated outage.

items.title: Ticketing System Multi-Tenant Queue Configuration
items.description: Configure support ticketing queues with automated routing based on customer subscription tier and severity.
items.requiredEvidence: Configured ticketing queue endpoints and SLA escalation rules
items.acceptanceCriteria: Automated SMS/Email alerts triggered if P1 issue unacknowledged within 60 minutes.

items.title: End-Client Customer Satisfaction (CSAT/NPS) Survey System
items.description: Deploy automated 30-day post-onboarding satisfaction survey to benchmark end-user adoption and support quality.
items.requiredEvidence: CSAT survey instrument and automated survey trigger hooks
items.acceptanceCriteria: Target CSAT benchmark established at $\ge 85\%$ across all live client deployments.

items.title: Franchise Application & Due Diligence Questionnaire
items.description: Create comprehensive application form capturing candidate business background, commercial references, and territory choice.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Form covers PAN, Aadhaar, capital declaration, and non-guaranteed earnings acknowledgement.

items.title: Partner KYC Dossier & Background Verification Protocol
items.description: Establish formal identity, police verification, credit bureau check (CIBIL $\ge 700$), and commercial reference check process.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Mandatory KYC verification completed for 100% of candidate principals prior to LOI issuance.

items.title: Bank Statement Proof-of-Funds Verification Protocol
items.description: Verify unencumbered bank balance demonstrating candidate has setup CapEx (₹75k) + minimum ₹50,000 liquid working capital cushion.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Written verification signed by CA or certified bank statement review on file.

items.title: Partner Welcome Kit & Collateral Dispatch SOP
items.description: Standardize physical welcome box: acrylic desk plaque, visiting cards, software manuals, marketing standee, and official certificate.
items.requiredEvidence: Welcome kit inventory checklist in franchise-model/onboarding-journey.md
items.acceptanceCriteria: Dispatch timeline $< 5$ business days post-contract signing.

items.title: 13 Core Franchise KPI Tracking Dashboard Specification
items.description: Specify executive telemetry dashboard monitoring sales velocity, EBITDA, renewal retention, and support SLAs across territories.
items.acceptanceCriteria: All 13 KPIs specified with source data pipelines, formulas, and alert thresholds.

items.title: Minimum Quarterly Software License Benchmark Quotas
items.description: Codify territory benchmark quotas (e.g. minimum 6 contracts per quarter post-ramp) required to maintain exclusivity.
items.requiredEvidence: Codified quota rules in assumptions.json and territory policy
items.acceptanceCriteria: Objective performance benchmark matrix with clear remediation cure periods.

items.title: Franchise Advisory Council (FAC) Governance Charter
items.description: Formulate governance framework for collaborative franchisee representation, quarterly sessions, and product roadmap reviews.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Clear election rules, advisory boundaries, and quarterly meeting cadences.

items.title: Management Decision Register & Policy Revision Log
items.description: Maintain immutable audit log recording all formal leadership decisions regarding fee revisions, waivers, and territory adjustments.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Every commercial exception backed by documented rationale and executive signatures.

items.title: Formal Approval Matrix Tracking Client Sign-Offs
items.description: Maintain centralized ledger of formal deliverable approvals and signing authorities.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Real-time tracking of deliverable status transitions from Draft to Client Approved.

items.title: Pilot Territory Demographics & Validation Brief (Pune, Satara, Baramati)
items.description: Analyze commercial potential, MSME density, and school counts across the 3 selected Wave 1 pilot territories.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Detailed demographic profile and target customer count for each of the 3 pilot talukas.

items.title: Wave 1 Pilot Launch & Audit Protocol Specification
items.description: Establish 30/60/90-day evaluation gates, promotional fee agreements (₹25,000), and governance committee responsibilities.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Clearly defined milestone gates and executive review criteria.

items.title: Selection & Contracting of Initial 3 Pilot Franchise Partners
items.description: Vet candidate operators for Pune, Satara, and Baramati; execute pilot agreements with verified working capital cushion.
items.requiredEvidence: Signed pilot franchise agreements and proof of fee receipts
items.acceptanceCriteria: 3 certified operators contracted with verified KYC and bank reserves.

items.title: 30-Day Pilot Operational Review & Lead Velocity Audit
items.description: Audit physical office setups, initial CRM lead generation velocity, and mock software demo completion for pilot units.
items.requiredEvidence: 30-Day audit memo with verified CRM pipeline export
items.acceptanceCriteria: Minimum 50 prospect accounts logged per pilot unit with zero critical SLA defects.

items.title: 60-Day Pilot Revenue & Commission Reconciliation Audit
items.description: Audit first commercial sales, billing generation, 18% GST remittance, and partner commission disbursements.
items.requiredEvidence: Reconciled billing statement and bank escrow disbursement logs
items.acceptanceCriteria: 100% of pilot client billings reconciled with zero partner split disputes.

items.title: 90-Day Pilot Completion Audit & National Expansion Gate Approval
items.description: Executive review evaluating pilot sales velocity, CSAT survey scores ($\ge 85\%$), and model financial reconciliation.
items.requiredEvidence: Final Pilot Performance Report and signed Gate 6 resolution
items.acceptanceCriteria: Formal board authorization clearing statewide expansion across Maharashtra.
